scientific_integrity: The facet classification is credited to its published source; the unrestricted radius, tangencies, center spans and balanced-even interval follow from explicit sign-norm and rank arguments, not finite experiments. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unit-root metric only; general weights and affine deformations excluded; for unequal sizes the complete center set has an exact finite inequality system, not a vertex enumeration. Earlier work already supplies the facet normals and counts. Historic priority of the newly optimized incenter locus is provisional.
title: Sharp inball parity and complete incenter loci of complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
